name: KiTS23: Kidney and Kidney Tumor Segmentation Challenge Dataset
description: The Kidney Tumor Segmentation 2023 (KiTS23) dataset provides 489 contrast-enhanced abdominal computed tomography (CT) scans of patients undergoing nephrectomy for suspected renal malignancy. Voxel-level ground truth delineations cover normal kidney parenchyma, renal tumors, and non-neoplastic renal cysts, rigorously reviewed and verified by expert surgical and radiology teams. Safeguard notice: Designed for algorithmic research on abdominal oncology segmentation; non-diagnostic tool; clinical deployment requires validated regulatory clearance.
